first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: snow-covered competition ski course
entities.identification: A broad white ski course that occupies most of the foreground and narrows into the distance, with blue route markings on its surface.

entities.name: blue route markings on the snow surface
entities.identification: Blue long lines, curved bands of color, and local short transverse branches on the ski course surface.

entities.name: protective facilities along the edge of the course
entities.identification: Red barriers with white signage extending along the left edge of the ski course, and the red mesh fencing above them.

entities.name: snow-covered coniferous forest
entities.identification: A group of dark-colored coniferous trees of varying heights outside the ski course, with cone-shaped crowns covered in white snow.

entities.name: blue-covered course equipment
entities.identification: A cropped cyan-blue portion at the extreme left edge of the image in frame 0, provisionally retaining the entity attribution from the source.

entities.name: tips of the red skis
entities.identification: Bright red, long, narrow ski tips with rounded ends that appear intermittently at the bottom edge of the image.

entities.name: gray-blue sky
entities.identification: A low-contrast gray-blue sky background above the outlines of the treetops and snowy slope.
